title: English Practice Quiz 0775
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: Education and Learning Skills 01: Active learning involves?
questions.explanation: Option A is correct: participating and applying new information.

questions.question: Education and Learning Skills 02: A study timetable helps learners?
questions.explanation: Option B is correct: organise time and learning tasks.

questions.question: Education and Learning Skills 03: A reliable reference source should be?
questions.explanation: Option C is correct: accurate, relevant and verifiable.

questions.question: Education and Learning Skills 04: Taking notes during a lesson can help?
questions.explanation: Option D is correct: retain and organise important information.

questions.question: Education and Learning Skills 05: A learning objective describes?
options: what a learner should be able to do
questions.explanation: Option A is correct: what a learner should be able to do.

questions.question: Education and Learning Skills 06: Constructive feedback helps learners?
options: identify strengths and areas to improve
questions.explanation: Option B is correct: identify strengths and areas to improve.

questions.question: Education and Learning Skills 07: A revision session is most effective when it?
questions.explanation: Option C is correct: uses active recall and practice.

questions.question: Education and Learning Skills 08: Plagiarism means?
options: presenting another person's work as your own
questions.explanation: Option D is correct: presenting another person's work as your own.

questions.question: Education and Learning Skills 09: A group assignment requires?
questions.explanation: Option A is correct: clear roles and shared responsibility.

questions.question: Education and Learning Skills 10: A learner who does not understand a topic should?
questions.explanation: Option B is correct: ask questions and seek clarification.
